title: lyciodes crenulatum
intro: Lyciodes crenulatum, commonly known as the Himalayan Sweet Leaf, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lyciodes crenulatum include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and anti-diabetic properties, making it a potential remedy for various infections and metabolic disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
